name: (Vampire, Nosferatu) Change Shape
text:
The nosferatu transforms into a swarm of pale-gray rats. They gain a land Speed of 30 feet and a climb Speed of 10 feet, and they become Large. In this swarm form, the nosferatu can take an action to deal each enemy in the swarm's space 2d10 piercing damage with a basic Reflex save save, with a high DC for the nosferatu's level. A creature that fails its save is also exposed to plague of ancients.
